## [1.3.3](https://github.com/TheDefaultState/meowdoku-patches/compare/v1.3.2...v1.3.3) (2026-10-31)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* tolerate a null tracking context when faking a reward ([b6a9631](https://github.com/TheDefaultState/meowdoku-patches/commit/b6a9631ff5f6beea28fa1ea674d4d5c25f2f211e))

patches.name: Block banner and native ads
patches.description: Skips banner and native ads entirely and collapses their space in the UI.

options.description: Stop loading inline ads and hide their containers.

patches.name: Block interstitial and app-open ads
patches.description: Skips the full-screen ads between levels and the ones shown when the app opens.

options.description: Skip the ad between levels and continue right away.

patches.name: Block rewarded ads
patches.description: Blocks rewarded ads, keeps the button visible without a loaded ad and grants the reward instantly.

options.description: Skip the ad, keep the button visible and grant the reward right away.

patches.name: Block telemetry
patches.description: Stops AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics and Facebook App Events from being started or sent anything.

options.description: Keep the analytics SDKs from starting and drop every queued event.
